seoTitle: ARIA Validator: Roles, States, Properties and Required Attributes
metaDescription: Check pasted HTML against WAI-ARIA 1.2: unknown roles, abstract roles, bad values, unsupported or missing attributes and broken ID references.
intro: Validates roles and aria-* attributes in HTML against WAI-ARIA 1.2.
why:
ARIA used wrongly is worse than none. Many mistakes are typos or attributes a role does not allow.

The data comes from the WAI-ARIA 1.2 Recommendation of 6 June 2023: roles, supported and required attributes with inheritance, value types and prohibited naming. It also checks ID references and aria-hidden on focusable elements. It does not know which HTML elements may take which role.
howTo: Treat review items as hints; scripts may satisfy them later.
Prefer native elements where you can.

faq.a: 1.2. Newer draft attributes are noted as info.
No. doc- and graphics- roles are noted but not checked.

faq.q: Why is a role flagged as redundant?
faq.a: The element already has that role, for example role="button" on a button.
